# src/solution.py
import csv
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

def main():
    # Read the original indicator matrix
    raw_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'
    df_raw = pd.read_csv(raw_path)

    # Basic column categorization
    meta_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
    indicator_cols = [c for c in df_raw.columns if c not in meta_cols]

    # Extract indicator values
    df_ind = df_raw[indicator_cols].copy()

    # --------- Median imputation ------------------------------------
    # Compute medians once
    medians = df_ind.median()
    df_imputed = df_ind.fillna(medians)

    # --------- Standard scaling ------------------------------------
    means = df_imputed.mean()
    stds = df_imputed.std(ddof=0)          # population std
    df_scaled = (df_imputed - means) / stds

    # --------- KMeans clustering ------------------------------------
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10, init='k-means++')
    labels = kmeans.fit_predict(df_scaled)

    # ---------- Write cluster assignments ----------------------------
    df_clusters = df_raw[meta_cols].copy()
    df_clusters['cluster_id'] = labels
    cluster_output = 'outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv'
    df_clusters.to_csv(cluster_output, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

    # ---------- Compute cluster profiles ----------------------------
    # Standard pandas aggregation on raw indicator values (before imputation)
    cluster_profiles = (
        df_raw.loc[:, indicator_cols]
        .groupby(labels)
        .apply(lambda g: g.dropna().mean())
    )
    # cluster_profiles has cluster_id as the index; reset index to keep as column
    cluster_profiles = cluster_profiles.reset_index()
    cluster_profiles = cluster_profiles.rename(columns={'index': 'cluster_id'})

    # Order columns: cluster_id then original indicator order
    cluster_profiles = cluster_profiles[['cluster_id'] + indicator_cols]

    profile_output = 'outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv'
    cluster_profiles.to_csv(profile_output, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
